name: Founder Mode
tagline: Stress-tests a startup idea and assembles the setup paperwork
description: Takes a raw idea through assumption-testing and trimming, checks whether the company name you want is actually free, and assembles a formation pack covering the LLC filing, EIN and business bank account. An evidence log keeps verified facts apart from the parts still resting on guesswork.
author: shiftynick
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
